heading: Tuesday, March 3, 2026
topLine: 2 model releases: Google Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite and OpenAI GPT-5.3 Instant.

items.headline: Google releases Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
items.summary: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite is a low-cost, low-latency Gemini 3 model for high-volume tasks such as translation and classification, with a 1M-token context window. It is priced at $0.25/$1.50 per million input/output tokens and launched in preview, reaching general availability on May 7.

items.headline: OpenAI makes GPT-5.3 Instant the ChatGPT default
items.summary: GPT-5.3 Instant replaced GPT-5.2 Instant as ChatGPT's default model, with fewer unnecessary refusals and better web-grounded answers. OpenAI reported 26.8% fewer hallucinations with web use and 19.7% fewer without, on internal evaluations.
